component.name: DeepARAM
component.summary: ARAM Mayhem tier list, builds and teamfight simulator

description.p: DeepARAM in its own window: the ARAM Mayhem tier list, augment and item rankings, champion pages, the fight simulator and test server changes.
It sends a notification when a new live patch or test server build lands, and remembers the page you used last.
